elements.text:
Getting started with Python

To learn Python effectively, focus on core programming skills such as syntax, debugging, and program development. Decide if you want to apply Python to data science, AI, or general programming. Beginners should start with foundational courses that cover Python basics and gradually move to specialized topics like data analysis or scripting. Consider your available time commitment and preferred learning style when choosing a course.

IBM

Python for Data Science, AI & Development

Best for: beginners with 1-3 months availability, learners interested in Python programming, and those seeking IBM-backed courses eager to build data science skills

University of Michigan

Python for Everybody
